text_block_list.text:
Long ago, I used to play coffee shop with 
my friend. My friend always played the 
master. And—

Unable to come up with a good training 
menu, I was walking and pondering, when—

text_block_list.name: Coffee Shop Employee
text_block_list.text:
...My, you look quite troubled. How about 
a cup of coffee at our shop? I just woke 
up and opened up for business.

The coffee shop before me—its quaint, 
vintage facade strangely draws in my 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Welcome. It seems you... will be our 
very last customer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I will brew you some coffee.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for waiting.

It was a masterpiece. Its charming 
expression captivates my gaze. Right into 
the cat's round, glassy eyes...
...I feel... drawn... in...—
Oi, wake the hell up!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Consciousness is... No jitter in the 
pupils. Normal. ...Just as I thought. At 
this stage, you're not completely gone 
yet.
choice_data_list: Wh-What's going on all of a sudden...?
Wh-What's the matter all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We're conducting an "Investigation into 
the Illogical Coffee Shop"! Shakur-san 
seemed really curious about it. It really 
is such a lovely shop, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Cafe... I already figured it out. It's all 
your doing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The key is—this coffee, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The latte art is a tool to guide gaze and 
focus attention. An altered state of 
consciousness—in short, it's a device to 
induce hypnosis.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What I don't get, though... is how you 
hypnotized them before they even saw the 
latte art.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. No matter how you look at it, it 
makes no sense.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You suddenly felt intrigued the moment you 
saw this place, right? Me and Doto 
too—hell, when I asked around, every 
single customer who came here said the 
exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, Cafe's working in this 
shop. Did that fact surprise you at all?

Now that she mentions it, I felt strongly 
drawn by the shop's exterior, and seeing 
Manhattan Cafe inside felt completely 
natural with zero sense of incongruity.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, that really is 
unnatural...

Now that you mention it, that really is 
bizarre...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I staked out this area because it bothered 
me... and sure enough, you came stumbling 
right in, sucked straight into this coffee 
shop.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Still, the trick to inducing that 
altered state, I haven't pinpointed it 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Cafe. How the hell did you pull it 
off? Come clean already.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...This shop simply... responds to those 
who seek it. I pour my feelings into it... 
and brew the coffee.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I do not know the logic. Nor is there a 
need to. That is... quite enough.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It is about time to bring this to an 
end.

In the very next moment, Manhattan Cafe 
took the coffee cup in her hands and—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No, Cafe-san!! You shouldn't eat 
something like th— Whoa...! S-So bright—!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...And with this, our long-awaited game of 
playing coffee shop is over. Thank you... 
for your hard work as the clerk.

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: *Meow*

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's enough for now. We ran out 
of coffee beans, after all.

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: *Meoowwn*

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Once we get new beans, we'll do 
it again. It felt nostalgic, and it was 
fun. And so—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Someday... I'd love to brew one. Just like 
the delicious, gentle cup my father used 
to serve his customers...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but next time we... run a shop, you 
mustn't force... customers to come in.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I know, you know... that you approached 
everyone. Transforming into a child, or a 
fishmonger...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Why were we standing out here 
again...?
choice_data_list: If I recall, we were at a coffee shop...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-Ahhh...! That's right~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We came to drink coffee because Cafe-san 
was helping out at a coffee shop, wasn't 
she!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah, that's right. The coffee 
wasn't half bad, either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Hey, it's almost curfew. I'm 
heading back. It's a pain in the ass if 
I'm late.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Shakur-san...! Pleeease wait for 
meee...!

...My head is still a little fuzzy. And— 
though vague, I have a strange feeling as 
if someone is gently watching over me—
choice_data_list:
Must be my imagination... I should head 
back too...

Must be my imagination... I'll head back 
to the academy too...

text_block_list.text:
...I shall be waiting for your next visit. 
Together with a cup brewed just for you.

In its heart, it whispered the nostalgic 
phrase shared with her. Watching the backs 
of the three returning to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: While scratching its ear with a hind leg.
